whoTheyAre.summary: This profile covers the specific Tajik source record in Tajikistan. The provider identity is paired with reference context on Tajik language and identity while avoiding claims about every Tajik individual.

religionAndCommunity.summary: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies this record under Sunni Islam. The classification is aggregate source metadata and is not extended to every Tajik person.

profile.whyUnreachedIntro: The unreached classification is explained with the provider's current mission-status and resource fields. Tajik ethnicity, Persian-language identity, or Islam is not treated as a causal shortcut.

whyUnreached.summary: The provider currently reports the Tajikistan record below its evangelical threshold with no active church-planting activity in the GSEC label.

whyUnreached.heading: Tajik-language resources are documented
whyUnreached.summary: The provider lists Tajik Bible and film resources, distinguishing mission-status classification from media availability.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org identifies PG024529 / PEID 24529 as Tajik in Tajikistan with Tajik (tgk) as the primary language; Encyclopaedia Iranica describes modern Tajiks as an Iranian people concentrated in Tajikistan and neighboring Central Asian areas and speaking varieties of Persian.
claims.interpretationNote: The reference source gives broad ethnolinguistic context; this editorial profile remains attached only to PG024529.

claims.text: Encyclopaedia Iranica describes Tajik identity as strongly connected to indigenous Central Asian Persian-speaking communities and notes Tajikistan's role as the modern national home of Tajiks.
claims.interpretationNote: This is broad historical and linguistic context and does not define the identity of every individual.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently classifies PG024529 under Sunni Islam.
claims.interpretationNote: This aggregate provider classification must not be read as an individual-level religious claim.

claims.text: PeopleGroups.org currently labels PG024529 'Less than 2% Evangelical, No Active CP Activity.'
claims.interpretationNote: This is the provider's current mission-status label for this source record.

claims.text: The PeopleGroups.org profile lists Tajik-language Bible resources and JESUS/Magdalena film resources.
claims.interpretationNote: Resource listings do not prove distribution, comprehension, use, or translation completeness.
